blurb: Guests fish for Pacific salmon and bottom fish in Clayoquot Sound using various techniques. Tours include wildlife viewing and optional add-ons like hiking and guided cultural walks. Boats are equipped with modern technology and safety features for comfort and reliability.
extraNote: Additional guests charged $25 per hour per guest · Hot Springs tours have a $150 fuel levy · Gratuities appreciated; average tip 15%-25% · Office at 605 Gibson St #109, Tofino, BC, near downtown and floatplane docks
